tools.name: effectcraft_list_commands
tools.description: [effectcraft] List engine commands: id, label, menu path, shortcut, `params` doc (e.g. `{name?, width?, height?, frameRate?, duration? (s)}`) and whether it can run now (`why` if not). Every menu item, shortcut and panel gesture maps to one of these ids; run them with execute_command. Narrow with `filter` (e.g. `layer.new`, `keys`, `effect`).

enabled_only.description: Only commands that can run right now.

filter.description: Only commands whose id or label contains this text (case-insensitive).

schemas.description: Also return each command's parameter JSON Schema (`schema`).

tools.name: effectcraft_describe_command
tools.description: [effectcraft] One command in full: id, label, menu path, shortcut, the `params` doc, a JSON Schema of its parameters (`schema`: properties, required, additionalProperties) and whether it can run now (`why` if not). Use before execute_command when unsure of the parameters; execute_command rejects unknown keys.

tools.name: effectcraft_execute_command
tools.description: [effectcraft] Run any engine command by id with JSON params; edits are undoable. Examples: comp.new {"name":"Main","width":1920,"height":1080,"frameRate":30,"duration":5}; layer.newText {"text":"Hello","size":120,"fill":"#ffffff"} (returns {"layer":id}); layer.newSolid {"color":"#3366ff"}; layer.newShape; effect.apply {"layer":3,"effect":"Gaussian Blur"}; time.set {"time":2.5}; layer.select {"layers":[3]}. Layers are referenced by id, "#n" or name; times are seconds.

params.description: Command parameters as documented by list_commands.

tools.name: effectcraft_run_script
tools.description: [effectcraft] Run JavaScript with an After Effects-style scripting object model (app, app.project, items.addComp, comp.layers.addSolid/addText/addShape/addNull/addCamera/addLight, layer.property("ADBE Transform Group").property("ADBE Position").setValueAtTime(t, v), Effects.addProperty("ADBE Gaussian Blur 2"), expressions, markers, renderQueue…). Every edit is an undoable engine command; app.beginUndoGroup/endUndoGroup make one undo step. Returns {ok, result (last expression value), output (writeLn/$.writeln/alert text), error: {message, line, column} | null}. File access is limited to the project folder unless the user allows scripts to write files.

code.description: JavaScript source, e.g. `var c = app.project.items.addComp("Main", 1920, 1080, 1, 5, 30); c.layers.addText("Hi"); c.numLayers`.

name.description: Script name used in error messages (default `script`).

tools.name: effectcraft_get_project
tools.description: [effectcraft] Project overview: file path, dirty flag, bit depth, every item (id, name, type Composition/Footage/Solid/Folder, size, duration, layer count), the active comp id, current time (s), selected layers and the undo stack.

tools.name: effectcraft_get_comp
tools.description: [effectcraft] A composition: id, name, size, frame rate, duration, work area, background and its layers top to bottom (id, index, name, type, in/out/start seconds, blend mode, parent, track matte, switches). Layer ids feed get_layer, get_property/set_property and commands.

comp.description: Composition item id or name; omit for the active comp.

tools.name: effectcraft_get_layer
tools.description: [effectcraft] A layer's property tree (transform, masks, effects, text, shape contents, ...): every node has a `path` usable with get_property/set_property/add_keyframe, plus uid, match id, name, type, value at `time`, keyframes and expression. `flat: true` returns just a list of {path, type, value, keys, expression} (compact).

comp.description: Composition item id or name; omit for the active comp.

flat.description: Return a flat list of properties instead of the tree.

layer.description: Layer id (from get_comp), "#n" (1-based index from the top) or layer name.

time.description: Comp time in seconds for values (default: current time).

tools.name: effectcraft_get_property
tools.description: [effectcraft] Read one property: type, value at `time` (comp seconds; default the current time), whether it is animated, its keyframes (time, value, in/out interpolation) and expression.

comp.description: Composition item id or name; omit for the active comp.

layer.description: Layer id (from get_comp), "#n" (1-based index from the top) or layer name.

path.description: Property path from get_layer: match ids joined by `/`, `#n` for the nth child, or `@uid`. E.g. `transform/position`, `transform/opacity`, `transform/scale`, `transform/rotation`, `effects/#1/blurriness`, `masks/#1/feather`, `@57`.

tools.name: effectcraft_set_property
tools.description: [effectcraft] Set a property. Without `time`: sets the static value (or a key at the current time if already animated). With `time`: adds/replaces a keyframe there, turning the stopwatch on. `expression` sets an After Effects-style JS expression ("" removes it). Returns the property as get_property does. Examples: {"layer":3,"path":"transform/opacity","value":50}; {"layer":"Title","path":"transform/position","value":[200,540],"time":0}; {"layer":3,"path":"transform/rotation","expression":"time*90"}.

comp.description: Composition item id or name; omit for the active comp.

expression.description: Expression text; empty string removes the expression.

layer.description: Layer id (from get_comp), "#n" (1-based index from the top) or layer name.

path.description: Property path from get_layer: match ids joined by `/`, `#n` for the nth child, or `@uid`. E.g. `transform/position`, `transform/opacity`, `transform/scale`, `transform/rotation`, `effects/#1/blurriness`, `masks/#1/feather`, `@57`.

time.description: Keyframe time in seconds (layer time; equals comp time unless the layer is offset/stretched).

value.description: Number for 1-D properties (50), array for vectors ([960,540]), "#rrggbb" or [r,g,b,a] (0-1) for colours, bool for checkboxes, string for text/menus.

tools.name: effectcraft_add_keyframe
tools.description: [effectcraft] Add keyframes to a property (turns the stopwatch on): one with `time` (+ optional `value`, default the current value) or many with `keys: [{time, value}]`, then optionally set their `interpolation`: linear, bezier, hold, easyEase, easyEaseIn, easyEaseOut. Example: {"layer":1,"path":"transform/position","keys":[{"time":0,"value":[0,540]},{"time":2,"value":[1920,540]}],"interpolation":"easyEase"}.

comp.description: Composition item id or name; omit for the active comp.

value.description: Number for 1-D properties (50), array for vectors ([960,540]), "#rrggbb" or [r,g,b,a] (0-1) for colours, bool for checkboxes, string for text/menus.

layer.description: Layer id (from get_comp), "#n" (1-based index from the top) or layer name.

path.description: Property path from get_layer: match ids joined by `/`, `#n` for the nth child, or `@uid`. E.g. `transform/position`, `transform/opacity`, `transform/scale`, `transform/rotation`, `effects/#1/blurriness`, `masks/#1/feather`, `@57`.

value.description: Number for 1-D properties (50), array for vectors ([960,540]), "#rrggbb" or [r,g,b,a] (0-1) for colours, bool for checkboxes, string for text/menus.

tools.name: effectcraft_add_effect
tools.description: [effectcraft] Apply an effect to a layer and optionally set its parameters in one undoable call. `effect` is an id (`ec.blur.gaussian`) or After Effects name (`Gaussian Blur`; see list_effects); `values` maps parameter ids to values, e.g. {"blurriness": 12}. One undo step; if a value fails, nothing is applied. Returns the instance `path` (`effects/#n`, for set_property / add_keyframe) and its parameters with their paths and current values.

comp.description: Composition item id or name; omit for the active comp.

effect.description: Effect id or name, e.g. `Gaussian Blur`, `Glow`, `Curves`, `ec.color.levels`.

layer.description: Layer id (from get_comp), "#n" (1-based index from the top) or layer name.

values.description: Parameter id -> value (ids are in the returned `params` paths), e.g. {"blurriness": 12}.

tools.name: effectcraft_list_effects
tools.description: [effectcraft] The effect registry: id, After Effects name, category, GPU and 32-bpc support. Narrow with `filter` (id, name or category text). Apply with add_effect.

filter.description: Only effects whose id, name or category contains this text.

tools.name: effectcraft_list_fonts
tools.description: [effectcraft] The font families text layers can use, bundled and installed on this machine: family, styles, origin (bundled / system / user) and the name in the font's own language. Narrow with `query`; `rescan` picks up fonts installed since launch. Set one with execute_command `layer.setText {"layer", "font", "style"}`.

query.description: Only families whose name (English or own-language) contains this text.

rescan.description: Look for fonts installed since launch first.

tools.name: effectcraft_get_state
tools.description: [effectcraft] Where things stand: the editor state (active comp, current time, selected layers/keys/items, open comps, tool, work area) plus what this build can do (`app`: version, command and effect counts, GPU effects, import/export formats, After Effects parity summary). Cheap; call it to re-orient after a series of edits.

tools.name: effectcraft_render_frame
tools.description: [effectcraft] Render a composition frame (default: the active comp at the current time) and return it as a PNG image, longest side `max_side` (default 960, 0 = full size). `path` also writes the PNG to disk; `inline: false` returns only the metadata. Use it to check your work.

comp.description: Composition item id or name; omit for the active comp.

inline.description: Include the image in the reply (default true).

max_side.description: Longest side in pixels (default 960; 0 = full comp size).

time.description: Comp time in seconds (default: current time).

transparent.description: Keep the frame's alpha (RGBA PNG, as an RGB + Alpha render writes it) instead of compositing over the comp's background colour.

tools.name: effectcraft_open_project
tools.description: [effectcraft] Open a project: `path` to an .ecproj file, `demo: true` for the built-in demo project, or `new: true` for an empty project. Returns the project overview.

tools.name: effectcraft_save_project
tools.description: [effectcraft] Save the project to its current file, or to `path` (Save As, .ecproj).

tools.name: effectcraft_undo
tools.description: [effectcraft] Undo the last `steps` edits (default 1). Returns the remaining undo stack.

tools.name: effectcraft_redo
tools.description: [effectcraft] Redo `steps` undone edits (default 1).

tools.name: effectcraft_history
tools.description: [effectcraft] The branching undo history (History panel): without arguments lists every state {index, id, label, parent, depth (0 = working line, >0 = branch), current, future}; undoing and then editing keeps the undone states as a branch. With `goto` (an index or id from the listing) jumps to that state, on any branch, without losing the others.

goto.description: State index or id to jump to (edit.history.goto).

tools.name: effectcraft_script_ui
tools.description: [effectcraft] Drive ScriptUI windows that scripts opened (dialogs, palettes, dockable panels). action `list` (default): open windows; `get`: a window's control tree (type, name, text, value, checked, items, selection, bounds); `click`: press a button / toggle a checkbox / pick a radio button; `set`: type text, move a slider, pick a list item (index or text); `close`: close a window (`result` for a dialog's show(), default 2 = Cancel). Controls by id, "#id", properties.name or text. A dialog's script resumes when the dialog closes.

result.description: For `close`: what the dialog's show() returns.

value.description: For `set`: text, number, bool, item index or item text.

window.description: Window id or title (optional when one is open).

tools.name: effectcraft_batch
tools.description: [effectcraft] Run several engine commands in one call as ONE undo step (engine.batch). Later steps can use earlier results: a string param "$N" or "$N.key" is step N's result (1-based), e.g. create a layer, then key and style it: {"steps":[{"command":"layer.newText","params":{"text":"Hi","name":"Title"}},{"command":"prop.addKey","params":{"layer":"$1.layer","path":"transform/opacity","time":0,"value":0}},{"command":"effect.apply","params":{"layer":"$1.layer","effect":"Glow"}}]}. Returns {steps, results}. If a step fails the whole batch is rolled back (unless atomic: false) and the error names the step.

atomic.description: Roll everything back when a step fails (default true).
